subject: Request: telemetry sampling manifest & chain-of-custody for SOC 2 evidence
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@crestline.com>, Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@crestline.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: telemetry sampling manifest & chain-of-custody for SOC 2 evidence

Hi Anna / Rajiv —

Thanks for the heads up about the upcoming SOC 2 readiness window. To keep things efficient on our side, can you confirm the exact slices you want us to produce for the evidence bundle? Specifically we can provide:

- Admin activity logs (console/API/operator actions)
- Operator ledger (instance lifecycle, node assignments)
- Access trails (sign-in, MFA events, IPs)
- Model-serving request traces (token-level telemetry — summarized)

Requests we typically see from auditors that speed review: a CSV manifest with a representative sample of file names + time ranges, a short sampling plan explanation, and a signed chain-of-custody receipt when we hand over the bundle.

Attached is a lightweight telemetry_manifest_template.csv you can use as an example of the columns we can emit (source, start_ts, end_ts, filename, sha256, redaction_applied).

High-level constraints: default retention for live admin activity is 90 days; we can produce point-in-time snapshots older than that only if previously archived or if you request an export window (we can stage an S3 snapshot).

What we need from you:
1) Confirm which log types + date ranges for the sample (example: admin activity, 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30)
2) Target sample size (number of files / percentage) or a sampling cadence (every Nth file)
3) Any required redaction rules for PII before transfer
4) Preferred delivery method (S3 presigned zip, Drive link, or signed tarball via transfer)

Timeline: if you confirm scope by EOD Monday (11/23) we can prepare a sample manifest and dispatch a formal packet + DocuSign custody receipt by Tues (11/24).

Thanks — happy to hop on a short call if useful.

– Soojin
Soojin Lee | Security & Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: telemetry_manifest_template.csv (CSV, 3 KB)]

From: Anna Gomez <anna.gomez@crestline.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rajiv.patel@crestline.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: telemetry sampling manifest & chain-of-custody for SOC 2 evidence

Thanks Soojin — this is exactly the level of detail we need. A few clarifications from our side:

- Scope: admin activity + access trails for production tenant "crestline-prod"; sample window: 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30.
- Sample size: 10% of daily log files, min 25 files, whichever is greater (we want enough variation across weekdays/weekends).
- Redaction: redact IPs to /24 and replace usernames with stable pseudonyms (we'll provide a mapping format if needed).
- Delivery: S3 presigned link preferred; if that is not feasible we can accept a password-protected zip on Drive.

Also we require a signed custody receipt (DocuSign acceptable) for the handoff and a short manifest that lists checksums and who exported the artifacts. If you can include the sampling_plan.docx with the selection algorithm we'll route internally.

Our deadline for ingest is 11/27 COB — is that achievable?

— Anna
Anna Gomez | IT Audit Manager | Crestline Health

Subject: Re: Request: telemetry sampling manifest & chain-of-custody for SOC 2 evidence

Anna — quick internal note and proposed plan below.

What we can produce and how:
- Sources and format:
  * Admin activity: newline-delimited JSON records, one file per day per tenant (fields: ts, actor, action, resource, request_id, ip, user_agent, result, username_hash).
  * Access trails: compressed CSV (ts, username_hash, event, ip_trunc, region).
  * Operator ledger: JSON lines describing orchestration actions (node_id, event, ts, operator_id).

- Retention / historical availability:
  * Live retention: 90 days by default for admin activity and access trails.
  * Snapshots: we can produce a point-in-time snapshot for any requested month if data still exists in object store. For older ranges we can only include previously archived snapshots.

- Sampling algorithm (attached):
  * Stratified by day and event_type. Select 10% of files with a minimum of 25 files across the window; within each selected file sample the first 500 events and the last 500 events to capture boundary behaviour.

- Redaction: we will apply deterministic username pseudonymization and IP truncation (/24). We will record the mapping salt and the method in the manifest but will not share raw mappings.

- Delivery options:
  * Option A (preferred): S3 presigned URL to a password-protected tar.gz containing files + manifest + custody_receipt.pdf (signed).
  * Option B: Drive link with password-protected zip.
  * Option C: We can provide an AWS Snowball style encrypted appliance for very large archives (rare).

Attached: sampling_plan.docx with the selection steps and a sample manifest example.

If 11/27 COB is the deadline, we can prepare the manifest and a first sample by EOD 11/25, but we will need your confirmation on redaction specifics and the S3 bucket destination.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Director, Trust & Safety Engineering | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sampling_plan.docx (DOCX, 48 KB)]

Anna / Rajiv — thanks for the confirmation. Per Karthik's plan we will:

1) Apply the stratified 10% sampling across 2026-09-01 -> 2026-09-30 with min 25 files.
2) Pseudonymize usernames and truncate IPs to /24.
3) Produce an S3 presigned package containing: sample files, telemetry_manifest.csv (columns: source,start_ts,end_ts,filename,sha256,redaction_applied,exported_by), sampling_plan.pdf, and a custody_receipt.pdf.

Next steps / action items:
- Anna: confirm S3 bucket destination and whether Crestline wants the manifest to include username pseudonyms or only hashes.
- Rajiv: please confirm you and your audit team can accept S3 presigned urls (if not we will produce Drive password-protected zip).
- Karthik / Naomi: prepare manifest + custody_receipt and upload to staging bucket once we have confirmations.

DocuSign custody receipt created here: https://docusign.com/embedded/ABC123 (we will send to Anna for signature once you confirm acceptance). I also opened a HubSpot ticket to track delivery: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/ticket/RED-98765.

Target: sample manifest to Anna by 11/25 EOD and full packet to Crestline by 11/27 COB. If anything slips we'll notify immediately.

Thanks — Soojin
